name: google_maps_get_place_address
intent: Look up the street address of a place in Google Maps
description: Search for a named place in Google Maps, open its details, scroll to reveal its address, and return the street address.
patterns: what is the address of a place
find the street address for a place in Maps

inputs.name: place_name
inputs.description: The name of the place to search for

steps.intent: Tap the search field to start a search
Type {{place_name}} into the search field and open the matching place
Scroll down to reveal the street address in the place details
